args: set -e; rel='mcp-server/dist/server.mjs'; for base in "$PWD/packages/copilot-cli-plugin" "$PWD" "$HOME/.copilot/installed-plugins/_direct/copilot-cli-plugin" "$HOME/.copilot/installed-plugins/_direct"/* "$HOME/.copilot/installed-plugins"/*/*; do [ -f "$base/plugin.json" ] || continue; grep -Eq '"name"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"omcp"' "$base/plugin.json" || continue; if [ -f "$base/$rel" ]; then exec node "$base/$rel"; fi; done; echo "omcp MCP launcher could not find $rel from cwd=$PWD" >&2; exit 1
